items.title: Israel’s election ended in deadlock. Here are four ways out
items.brief: Israel faces weeks, possibly months, of political limbo after final results show there’s no clear winner in its elections .

items.title: Mushroom killer to be jailed for life after appeals court finds sentence too light
items.brief: An attempt by murderer Erin Patterson, who killed three people with a meal of toxic mushrooms, to overturn her conviction has failed, with an appeals court finding that her original sentence was too light.

Russia strikes Dnipro train station in central Ukraine, killing 14
items.brief: A Russian drone struck the main railway station in the central Ukrainian city of Dnipro as people waited to board a train on Thursday morning, killing 14 people.

items.title: Judge sharply questions lawyers over request to remove Letitia James from Cornell sex assault investigation
items.brief: A New York judge on Thursday sharply questioned attorneys over a request to remove Attorney General Letitia James from her role as the special prosecutor investigating sexual assault allegations at Cornell University .

items.title: The final Israeli election results are in. Netanyahu hasn’t won – but he hasn’t lost either
items.brief: No clear winner has emerged from Israel’s election with all the votes counted, according to the Israeli Central Elections Committee.
